long_biography.plain_text:
Born in September 1965, Andrea Invernizzi is an Italian national resident in Switzerland. He held a controlling interest in MF1-24 Performance, a British company registered to sell used cars before its dissolution. His broader business career and the origins of his wealth remain private.

His visible sporting identity centres on GT competition. He raced Ferrari F430 and 458 cars with Black Bull Swiss Racing in European endurance, Blancpain and Italian events. Across a seven-year span he won at Imola, achieved repeated podium and pole results, returned for an official Black Bull test and received an FIA Bronze driver categorisation.
